habitats: Moist fissure lines outside the central spring basin
summary: A stout, seasonally thinning tree carries separated foliage tiers above spreading anchoring roots. Occasional mature hollows sound in suitable wind. It provides climbable branches and shelter without forming a western fog forest.

chains.trait: Stout trunk, flexible porous crown and occasional humming hollow
links: Heavy-air winds impose strong bending loads
Low leverage, crown gaps and anchoring roots limit loading
An age-formed cavity can resonate only with suitable airflow and geometry
chains.play: Climb sound branches and learn a conditional acoustic bearing.
chains.weakness: Decay weakens wood; calm trees are silent and storms mask sound.

plausibility.summary: Porosity alone produces no guaranteed tone. Approximately 80–200 Hz requires validated cavity geometry; propagation follows weather.

analogues.mechanism: Flexible branching and mature decay cavities provide structural analogues; tuned cavity sound is a conditional physical extrapolation.

chains.trait: Deep roots, small leaves and partial summer leaf shed
links: Eastern summer drought limits water supply
Deep roots reach persistent subsurface moisture
Small leaves and seasonal shedding reduce demand
chains.play: Compare seasonal shade and identify moisture-supported tree stands.
chains.weakness: Shallow dry soil prevents establishment; still fog provides little interception.
observe: Find drip only during moving fog.

plausibility.summary: Subsurface water supports the tree; fog interception is supplementary and requires droplet movement.

analogues.mechanism: Deep-rooted woodland trees combine restricted foliage with seasonal adjustment to summer water shortage.

links: Aerodynamic drag slows winged seed descent
Wind carries samaras beyond the parent
Sheltered moist microsites permit seedling survival
chains.play: Track drifting samaras and find seedlings beneath nurse shrubs.
chains.weakness: Dispersal into exposed dry ground usually fails.

plausibility.summary: Dense air aids descent control without guaranteeing distance or establishment.

analogues.mechanism: Winged samaras use aerodynamic drag and autorotation for wind dispersal.

gameplay.cover: Seasonal shade, lee shelter and elevated refuge.
gameplay.nest_material: Fine fallen twigs and dry leaf strips.
gameplay.notes: Climbing can interrupt garfio pursuit; predators may wait below. Cavities require maturity. Trees offer no guaranteed lightning protection.

relations.note: Uses sturdy forks for perching and launch.
May wait beneath occupied refuge branches.
Shrubs shelter seedlings; mature roots later compete for water.
Supports vines only to actual crown height.
Restricted to persistently damp illuminated grooves.

generator.trunk: Fluted, 0.4–0.65 m diameter; three to five major spreading roots.
generator.seasonal: Partial summer leaf shed; dry 30–40 mm samaras disperse seasonally.
generator.wind_response: Asymmetric lee crown with 35–50% gaps; usually 5–8 m, reaching 9 m only in shelter.

journal.en: Wind crosses the crown. One old hollow lends it a voice.
journal.es: El viento cruza la copa. Un hueco viejo le presta voz.

changelog.what: flora addendum (start valley): 7 voices drafted and peer-reviewed, Composer referee, sol chaired

secrets: Most mature trees never develop a sounding cavity.
